title: agentictools project configuration
description: Checked into each consuming project root as agentictools.config.json. Selects which central modules the agents should load.

agentictoolsHome.description: Path to the central agentictools repo. The AGENTICTOOLS_HOME environment variable wins if set.

profile.description: Base preset defined in the central agentictools.json.

maxRules.description: Maximum number of rule files to load. 0 = unlimited.

syncGeneratedDirs.description: Create per-agent symlinks/dirs for enabled modules.

targets.description: Limit which agents get generated artifacts. Omit for all.

include.description: Module ids to enable. Use "*" for all.

exclude.description: Module ids to disable, applied after include/profile.
